title: Learning Management System
tagline: A learning platform website enabling users to teach, learn, communicate, and manage educational content.
overview: Developed a learning management system website where users can act as both teachers and learners. The platform supports course creation, lesson and assessment management, user administration, messaging, video calling and payment methods.
problem: Educational platforms require an integrated system that allows users to seamlessly switch between teaching and learning while managing course content, assessments, and communication in one place.
solution: Designed and implemented a modular learning platform featuring user management, course and lesson management, quizzes, messaging, and video calling, allowing users to both create courses and enrol in others.
metrics: Supports dual-role users who can be both teachers and learners
Course management with lessons and structured lesson content
Built-in messaging and video calling between users
Modular architecture separating user, content, and communication features
keyContributions: Appropriate privileges between user as a teacher and as a student
Secure user login with hashed database
learningPoints: Learnt how to design software around multiple user roles with different permissions
Learnt how to implement a password reset
Gained experience developing CRUD workflows for hierarchical entities such as courses and lessons
Improved understanding of building with Model, View Template Django framework
Learnt the importance of designing extensible systems that support future feature expansion

challenges.title: Supporting users with multiple roles
challenges.description: Designed the platform so every user could simultaneously act as a teacher by publishing courses while also enrolling as a learner in other courses.

challenges.title: Managing hierarchical learning content
challenges.description: Structured relationships between courses, lessons, lesson content, and quizzes while keeping the application maintainable and easy to navigate.

challenges.title: Button for user to retrieve their location rather than typing
challenges.description: Used an open API to determine the country by reverse geocoding.
